character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create a single pixel art game character asset.

A Joseon dynasty Taoist mage character for a roguelike survival game.

Style:
- 32-bit pixel art style
- clean pixel edges
- high quality indie game sprite
- similar to modern pixel RPG games
- detailed but readable at small size
- limited color palette
- no blur
- no realistic rendering

Character:
- young Korean male Taoist
- wearing a traditional black gat hat
- white and dark gray Joseon robe
- gold embroidery details
- black inner clothing
- traditional Korean mage appearance
- holding a wooden staff with a yellow talisman attached
- mysterious but heroic expression

Pose:
- full body
- standing idle pose
- front facing view
- centered character
- feet visible
- game sprite proportion
- chibi but not cute
- suitable for Vampire Survivors style gameplay

Requirements:
- transparent background
- PNG sprite asset
- only the character
- no background
- no UI
- no text
- no shadow
- no scenery
- no additional objects

Game asset style:
pixel art character sheet quality,
ready to use in a 2D roguelike game.Inspired by Korean folklore and Joseon fantasy.
The character should feel like a supernatural hunter who fights ghosts and monsters using talismans and magic.
Avoid Japanese samurai or Chinese wuxia style.
Focus on Korean Joseon visual identity.
